reason: My order book is full for months, so a caller who never rings back is not money I lose. Paying 99 euros a month to catch more requests I can't take on anyway makes no sense right now.
objection: I don't want to touch my phone setup or my number, and I'd be handing my customers' first contact to a brand-new company with no customers that could break or annoy my regulars.
would_change_my_mind: If the free check showed regular customers or emergency jobs getting lost, not just new enquiries, I might try the 'ausgebucht' mode to filter calls.
